# Requirement Clarification Rules

Use this checklist before producing outputs when requirement context is incomplete.

## Rules

- Ask clarification questions when scope, actor, system behavior, or expected result is ambiguous.
- Do not invent business rules or acceptance criteria.
- Prefer explicit assumptions only when the user accepts them.
- Mark blockers clearly when missing information prevents reliable output.
- Keep questions specific, actionable, and prioritized by impact.

## Clarification Triggers

- Missing preconditions, postconditions, or business constraints.
- Unclear validation rules, state transitions, or error handling.
- Incomplete integration details (API contract, dependencies, permissions).
- Ambiguous terminology that can lead to multiple interpretations.

## Output Expectations

- Separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
- List unresolved questions in numbered order.
- Proceed only with deterministic and supported information.
